reviews.title: Performance Issues After Purchase
reviews.text:
Prior to purchasing, I used the 7‑day trial and everything worked flawlessly. Once I bought the full version, the lock‑screen widget began freezing constantly, the app became extremely slow to respond, and I now have to force‑close it repeatedly just to get it to function. I verified that my device and the app were fully up to date, so that’s not the issue.

If I could go back, I would not have purchased this app. I do not recommend it to others.

reviews.title: I LOVE this water tracking app!!!
reviews.text: I am loving the layout of this app! It is cute yet sophisticated in its design; it really does help me drink water! With tons of different layout options, you can also customize it to work best with you! This app is useful because of its easy access, and thoughtfulness! It’s encouraging, too! The only thing that a cheapskate like we wouldn’t entirely like would be some of the perks that only work with paying. But still, this app makes the main idea of drinking more water extremely accessible to all! If you struggle like your water intake, like me, get this app to help you in your journey!!!

reviews.title: Keeps getting better

reviews.title: My Water Review
reviews.text: My water helps me keep track of how much water I drink and need in a day! It’s a really easy sign in! And if u click the notification button it will give u encouraging words to help!!!  My water takes in your height,weight, and age and tells you exactly how much water intake you should have in a day!! My water would be a 5 star except for the fact that I don’t like how a lot of stuff u do has to be premium!! But I understand that for certain apps!! This app has rarely any ads! And overall is really good!! I definitely recommend if ur trying to drink more water, or trying to track how much u drink!!
